summary: Highlander Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing condensed consolidated interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three months ended March 31, 2026, and 2025. This is a routine periodic report with no mention of any special-situation transaction. The filing includes certifications and unaudited financial data showing revenues, expenses, and a net income of $20.4 million for the period. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16.
